findings.message: this ADR was accepted at HEAD, and has changed by more than a typo since: `## Decision`. A decided ADR changes only by a new ADR that supersedes it. Restore the text, and write the new decision in an ADR naming adr-0001 in `supersedes`.
adr-0003 was `accepted` at HEAD, and no record here has that id now. Something outside the corpus may still cite adr-0003, so restore the record and retire it through its `status`.

this postmortem was published at HEAD, and has changed by more than a typo since: `## Root cause`. A published account changes only by a typo fixed, a link corrected, a reflow or an `accepts` entry. Restore the text, and write what was learnt since in a new postmortem that links to pmt-0001.
